summary.en: Gunmen attacked villages in Nigeria, killing 24 civilians. Bandits in Niger State killed an immigration officer and set his body on fire, and similar bandit raids continued in Borgu LGA. Ethnic tension rose as Ijaw leaders warned of crisis after an alleged attack in an Edo court, while ex-militants in Akwa Ibom pledged support for President Tinubu’s re-election. A Niger lawyer was jailed for a social-media post about the army, and ECOWAS leaders met with the junta in a panel photo. The conflict produced 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.extract: The War in the Sahel, also known synonymously as the Sahel War is a multi-sided armed conflict that has been ongoing since 2012. In particular, the intensive conflict mainly takes place in the three countries of Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso.
